title: Lou recast — Ash — line 12
direction: Lou is a middle-aged American gas station manager, an ex-crook who has settled into ordinary work. Easy everyday rhythm, clear words, small natural pauses. The texture is in the voice, not in exaggerated growling. Play the conversation casually and sincerely. Move the conversation along to an errand.
